# msix

**Tag**: windows, tool, mobile, desktop, ui, tooling

## 简介

A command-line tool that create Msix installer from your flutter windows-build files.

- 主页: https://github.com/YehudaKremer/msix
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/YehudaKremer/msix/issues
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/msix
